hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | awk '/^\*\*\* (Add|Update) File: / { sub(/^\*\*\* (Add|Update) File: /, ""); if (!seen[$0]++) print } /^\*\*\* Move to: / { sub(/^\*\*\* Move to: /, ""); if (!seen[$0]++) print }' | while IFS= read -r f; do case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.astro) case "$f" in /*) path=$f;; *) path=$root/$f;; esac; [ -f "$path" ] || continue; out=$("$root/node_modules/.bin/eslint" --fix --max-warnings=0 --no-warn-ignored "$path" 2>&1); rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | /usr/bin/grep -v projectService >&2; exit 2; };; esac; done
